dialog.english:
Soon, I will finish my barrier of 
fog. I shall turn this world into 
Hell. Mwahahaha...
dialog.translation:
Pronto acabaré mi barrera de
niebla. Convertiré este mundo
en un infierno. Mwahahaha...

Puaj, la tierra de Tokio sabe
fatal.

dialog.english:
You get your nutrients from the
soil, so is it like your dinner?
dialog.translation:
Sacas tus nutrientes de la
tierra, así que ¿es como tu cena?

dialog.english:
Something like that. I wonder why
it tastes so bad...
dialog.translation:
Algo así. Me pregunto por qué
sabe tan mal...

dialog.english:
You know, until recently this area
was part of the sea.
dialog.translation:
¿Sabes? Hasta hace poco esta zona
era parte del mar.

dialog.english:
Huh? Over there...Mimi! Mimi, is
that you?

Huh? Over there...Mimi! Mimi, is
that you?

You could pretend to be a stuffed
animal, but I don't want my
parents to think I have bad taste.
dialog.translation:
Podrías fingir ser un peluche,
pero no quiero que mis padres
piensen que tengo mal gusto.

dialog.english:
So you're saying that I'm... in
bad taste?

Ah! Don't think too much about it.
Heehee.
dialog.translation:
¡Ah! No le des muchas vueltas.
Jiji.

dialog.english: What are you up to at this hour?

Oh, no real reason... oh, to pick
you up! You're back late today.
dialog.translation:
¡Oh, sin motivo... ah, venir a
buscarte! Hoy vuelves tarde.

dialog.english:
The train was delayed by all the
fog. Okay, let's go home.
dialog.translation:
El tren se retrasó por la niebla.
Vale, vámonos a casa.

dialog.english:
Mama! Did you come to pick me up
as well?

Yeah! I finished making dinner, so
I came right away to get you!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! ¡Terminé de hacer la cena,
vine enseguida a por ti!

dialog.english:
So what's on the menu for today,
Mama?

Kimchi fried rice, topped with
strawberries and whipped cream!
dialog.translation:
¡Arroz frito con kimchi, con
fresas y nata montada!

dialog.english:
Be sure to eat 'til you're
stuffed!

Ugh, how long do I have to keep
hiding?

54 percent. It's the lowest score
I've gotten in all eleven years of
my life...
dialog.translation:
Un 54. Es la nota más baja que
saqué en mis once años de vida...

dialog.english:
Cheer up! Life's got its ups and
downs.

I've been stuck here all day, I
need to call home...
dialog.translation:
Llevo todo el día aquí metido,
debo llamar a casa...

dialog.english:
That's weird. There's no dial
tone.

Wait 'til tomorrow. I'll call the
others, and we'll go save her.
dialog.translation:
Espera a mañana. Llamaré a los
demás y la rescataremos.

dialog.english:
Kari, Tai can't sleep either.
Be patient for now and try to get
some rest.
dialog.translation:
Kari, Tai tampoco puede dormir.
Ten paciencia e intenta
descansar.

dialog.english:
Don't worry, your big bro will
take care of it!
dialog.translation:
¡Tranquila, tu hermano se
encargará de todo!

dialog.english:
Mr. Ishida, we've got trouble! Our
signal isn't reaching anywhere!
dialog.translation:
¡Sr. Ishida, problema! ¡Nuestra
señal no llega a ningún sitio!

dialog.english:
The cause is unknown. The only
thing the broadcasting system's
showing is the fog.
dialog.translation:
Se desconoce la causa. Lo único
que muestra el sistema es la
niebla.

dialog.english:
Land lines and cell phone lines
won't connect. Where are you
going?
dialog.translation:
Las líneas fijas y móviles no
conectan. ¿A dónde vais?

dialog.english:
Isn't it obvious? To investigate!
That's our job!

dialog.translation: Aquí está el área de la niebla.

dialog.english:
It's only covering Odaiba, and
it's a tight cover at that...
dialog.translation:
Solo cubre Odaiba, y encima muy
ajustada...

dialog.english:
I think we might want to head back
to the station sometime around
now...
dialog.translation:
Creo que deberíamos volver a la
estación dentro de poco...

dialog.english:
Could there be some kind of
connection between the fog and the
monster incidents?
dialog.translation:
¿Podría haber relación entre la
niebla y los incidentes de
monstruos?

dialog.english:
That's weird, nobody's picking up
at all...

Hey, Tai. Don't you have to
leave for morning practice?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Tai. ¿No tienes que ir al
entreno de la mañana?

dialog.english:
I have something else to deal with
right now!
dialog.translation:
¡Tengo algo más importante que
hacer ahora!

dialog.english:
See? Your teammates came to get
you.
dialog.translation:
¿Ves? Tus compañeros vienen a
por ti.

dialog.english:
Per Lord Myotismon's orders, we're
bringing all of you in!
dialog.translation:
¡Por orden del Amo Myotismon, os
llevamos a todos!

dialog.english:
Resistance is futile! Come, we'll
bring you to Lord Myotismon!
dialog.translation:
¡Resistirse es inútil! ¡Venid ante
el Amo Myotismon!

dialog.english:
I'm sorry, Tai! I promise I'll
save your mom when I get the 
chance! But we have to run away!
dialog.translation:
¡Lo siento, Tai! ¡Prometo salvar a
tu madre en cuanto pueda! ¡Pero
hay que huir!

dialog.english:
I'm not joking. Kari is the
eighth Chosen Child.
dialog.translation:
No es broma. Kari es el octavo
Niño Elegido.

dialog.english:
Anyway, what the heck happened to
you?

My old man woke me up and told me
to hide here.
dialog.translation:
Mi padre me despertó, dijo que me
escondiera.

dialog.english:
He says the fog's covering all of 
Odaiba, and it's preventing us 
from contacting the outside world.
dialog.translation:
Dice que la niebla cubre todo
Odaiba, y nos impide contactar
con el exterior.

dialog.english:
You mean all of Odaiba's been cut
off from the outside world?
dialog.translation:
¿Dices que todo Odaiba está
aislado del mundo exterior?

dialog.english:
Yeah. It's probably because of
Myotismon.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Seguro que es por culpa de
Myotismon.

dialog.english:
So he's cutting off Odaiba so he
can get his hands on Kari?
dialog.translation:
¿O sea que aísla Odaiba para poder
atrapar a Kari?

dialog.english:
And kidnapping adults and children
left and right...
dialog.translation:
Y secuestrando adultos y niños
sin parar...

dialog.english:
No! It's not your fault, it's
Myotismon's!
dialog.translation:
¡No! ¡No es culpa tuya, es de
Myotismon!

dialog.english:
Listen, Kari. Stay right here
and leave this to your big bro.
dialog.translation:
Escucha, Kari. Quédate aquí y
déjaselo a tu hermano mayor.

dialog.english:
Matt! I can leave Kari to you,
right?

Kari, I'll be sure to save Mom
and the others!
dialog.translation:
Kari, ¡salvaré a mamá y a los
demás, seguro!

dialog.english:
Yeah, leave it to me. Let's go,
Agumon!

Ah, I was careless. I used up all
our supply of soy sauce...
dialog.translation:
Ah, qué descuido. Se me acabó
toda la salsa de soja...

dialog.english:
Y-y...you, aren't you Sora's
stuffed animal! Except you're
not...
dialog.translation:
T-tú... ¿no eres el peluche de Sora?
Aunque no lo eres...

dialog.english:
Where does Sora have her morning
practice?
dialog.translation:
¿Dónde tiene Sora su entreno de la
mañana?

dialog.english:
The schoolyard at the elementary
school...
dialog.translation:
En el patio del colegio de
primaria...

dialog.english:
I have to go there! Sora is in
danger!
dialog.translation:
¡Tengo que ir allí! ¡Sora está en
peligro!

dialog.english:
This is... Sora's hat. I was too
late...
dialog.translation:
Es el gorro de Sora. Llegué
tarde...

dialog.english:
Looks like Myotismon brought all
the kidnapped humans here.
dialog.translation:
Parece que Myotismon trajo aquí a
los humanos secuestrados.

dialog.english: Let's go inside and look for her.

This might be a strange question,
but... about Sora. Has she ever 
said that she hates me?
dialog.translation:
Puede que sea rara la pregunta,
pero... sobre Sora. ¿Alguna vez
dijo que me odia?

dialog.english:
Neeeeever! Sora said that she was
able to understand your love.
dialog.translation:
¡Nuncaaaaa! Sora dijo que podía
entender tu amor.

dialog.english:
What's he up to, bringing all
these people here?
dialog.translation:
¿Qué tramará, trayendo a toda esta
gente aquí?

dialog.english: Hey, Mimi, can I stop hiding now?

No! If they find you, they might
separate us.

Mimi?! Mimi, did they get you,
too?

Yeah. And Papa and Mama, to
boot...
dialog.translation: Sí. Y a papá y mamá también...

dialog.english:
So you're here too, Palmon. We're
surrounded by enemies, so let's
just keep an eye out for now.
dialog.translation:
Conque tú también estás, Palmon.
Nos rodean enemigos, así que
esperemos.

dialog.english:
That big orange dinosaur could
have eaten our children by now...
dialog.translation:
Ese dinosaurio naranja podría
habernos comido ya a los niños...

dialog.english:
That dinosaur is on our side! I'm
sure he'll come to rescue us.
dialog.translation:
¡Ese dinosaurio está de nuestro
lado! Vendrá a rescatarnos.

dialog.english:
Are we all clear? The men will
take out the guards...
dialog.translation:
¿Listos? Los hombres se encargan
de los guardias...

dialog.english:
while the women and children will
use the diversion to escape.
dialog.translation:
mientras mujeres y niños escapan
con la distracción.

dialog.english:
Um... please don't let my husband
engage in such dangerous behavior!
dialog.translation:
Um... ¡por favor, no deje que mi
marido haga algo tan peligroso!

dialog.english:
Be quiet, dear! There are already
a loooooot of men here!
dialog.translation:
¡Cállate, cariño! ¡Ya hay un
montóoooon de hombres aquí!

dialog.english:
If my husband were to die here,
I'd have to join him in the
afterlife!!
dialog.translation:
¡¡Si mi marido muriera aquí,
tendría que acompañarlo al más
allá!!

dialog.english:
Okay, okay, got it. Please escort
the women, Mr. Tachikawa.
dialog.translation:
Vale, vale, entendido. Escolte a
las mujeres, Sr. Tachikawa.

dialog.english:
Oh, Sakurada? He listens to a
sutra whenever he gets too
stressed out.
dialog.translation:
Ah, ¿Sakurada? Escucha un sutra
cuando se estresa demasiado.

dialog.english: A sutra. Come to think of it...
dialog.translation: Un sutra. Ahora que lo dices...

dialog.english:
When we met some Bakemon on File
Island, Joe used a sutra to weaken
their power!
dialog.translation:
¡Cuando conocimos a unos Bakemon
en Isla File, Joe usó un sutra
para debilitarlos!

dialog.english:
Are you trying to make a run for
it?
We did it! We made it out!

I, I... I have to keep my pride as
a maaaaaaaan!
dialog.translation:
¡Yo... tengo que mantener mi
orgullo de hombreeee!

dialog.english: I'm sick of just waiting around!

Why are they doing this? This is
horrible! I can't let those
Digimon get away with this!
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué hacen esto? ¡Es horrible!
¡No dejaré que esos Digimon se
salgan con la suya!

dialog.english:
No, you're not. You're really
pretty! And cute!
dialog.translation:
No, para nada. ¡Estás muy guapa! ¡Y
mona!

dialog.english:
Hey, Mimi. Your pure heart is what
made me evolve, and I want to
protect it!
dialog.translation:
Oye, Mimi. ¡Tu corazón puro me
hizo evolucionar, y quiero
protegerlo!

dialog.english:
Good boy, good boy! Now he won't
be our enemy anymore!
dialog.translation:
¡Buen chico, buen chico! ¡Ya no
será nuestro enemigo!

dialog.english:
What a clever trick you've pulled
there!
dialog.translation:
¡Vaya truco más ingenioso el que
hiciste!

dialog.english:
Hahaha. All I did was dispose of
some trash that was taking up too
much space. You're next!
dialog.translation:
Jajaja. Solo tiré la basura que
ocupaba mucho espacio. ¡Tú eres la
siguiente!

dialog.english:
Hahaha... You're cute when you're
quiet...
dialog.translation:
Jajaja... eres mona cuando te
callas...

dialog.english: Take Lilimon and get out of here!
dialog.translation: ¡Llévate a Lilimon y sal de aquí!

dialog.english:
Why don't you pray to Buddha for a
peaceful death instead?
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué no rezas a Buda por una
muerte tranquila?

dialog.english: I won't let you do that!
I'll be fine! Get out of here!

Mom! Mimi! I promise I'll come
back here and save you!

Mom, Dad, I don't know when the
Bakemon will return...
dialog.translation:
Mamá, papá, no sé cuándo volverán
los Bakemon...

dialog.english:
Please remain here for now. You'll
be safe within the digital
barrier.
dialog.translation:
Quedaos aquí por ahora. Estaréis
a salvo en la barrera digital.

dialog.english:
Gennai said that the fog barrier 
around Odaiba is centered at the 
TV station, so I'm headed there.
dialog.translation:
Gennai dijo que la barrera de
niebla de Odaiba está centrada en
la tele, así que voy allí.

dialog.english:
...There's nothing I can say
that'll stop you from leaving, is
there...
dialog.translation:
...No hay nada que pueda decir
para que no te vayas, ¿verdad?...

dialog.english:
Let's believe in Izzy. He's
our son! He's come this far,
right?
dialog.translation:
Confiemos en Izzy. ¡Es nuestro
hijo! Ha llegado hasta aquí, ¿no?

dialog.english:
Be careful. You'll be sure to come
back safely, right? You'll come
back to us...
dialog.translation:
Ten cuidado. Volverás sano y
salvo, ¿verdad? Volverás con
nosotros...

dialog.english:
The center of the fog barrier
should be in this TV station. 
If we can just get rid of it...
dialog.translation:
El centro de la barrera de niebla
debería estar en esta tele. Si
nos deshacemos de ella...

dialog.english: Are we gon' be okay by ourselves?
This is bad. Let's go back.

Oh, no! We're surrounded on both
sides!

I thought I could take the water
bus home, but they've delayed all
the departures...
dialog.translation:
Pensaba coger el barco a casa,
pero retrasaron todas las
salidas...

dialog.english:
T.K! Did you come here by
yourself?

No, I came with my mom! And got
separated from her on the way...
dialog.translation:
¡No, vine con mi mamá! Y me separé
de ella por el camino...

dialog.english:
I see. Makes sense, in this
crowd...
Why aren't you in Odaiba, Joe?

Something happened while I was at
cram school.
dialog.translation:
Pasó algo mientras estaba en la
academia.
Seguro que es cosa de Myotismon.

dialog.english:
But I'm going to return to Odaiba,
no matter what.
dialog.translation:
Pero voy a volver a Odaiba, pase
lo que pase.

dialog.english:
I'll go, too! But how will we get
there?

We're counting on you, Gomamon. I
need you to evolve to Ikkakumon!
dialog.translation:
Contamos contigo, Gomamon.
¡Necesito que evoluciones a
Ikkakumon!

dialog.english:
T.K, get down from there! It's
dangerous!

It's okay, Mama! This is
Ikkakumon! He's our friend!

U-Um, nice to meet you! I'm Joe
Kido, a sixth-grader!
dialog.translation:
¡U-um, encantado! ¡Soy Joe Kido,
voy a sexto!

dialog.english:
I'll take responsibility for
T.K, so don't worry!
dialog.translation:
¡Me haré responsable de T.K., así
que no se preocupe!

dialog.english: Let's go find Matt and Daddy!
dialog.translation: ¡Vamos a buscar a Matt y a papá!

dialog.english:
T.K, are you seasick? If you
don't feel good, let me know right
away.
dialog.translation:
T.K., ¿estás mareado? Si no te
sientes bien, dímelo enseguida.

dialog.english:
Joe, you're acting kinda like my
mom.
dialog.translation:
Joe, actúas un poco como mi
madre.

dialog.english:
I made a promise to your mother
when we left her at Hinode Pier...
dialog.translation:
Prometí a tu madre, cuando la
dejamos en el Muelle de Hinode...

dialog.english:
I said I'd be responsible for
watching over you.
dialog.translation:
Dije que me haría responsable de
cuidarte.

dialog.english:
Hey, Joe! You're worrying too
much.

Did something over there move just
now?
dialog.translation:
¿Se movió algo por ahí ahora
mismo?

dialog.english:
We're in trouble! Joe fell into
the ocean!

Because I promised your mother
that I'd protect you...
dialog.translation:
Porque le prometí a tu madre que
te protegería...

dialog.english:
You finally evolved! You saved us,
Zudomon!

Hey, look! The light from Joe's
Crest is cutting a hole through
the fog!
dialog.translation:
¡Mirad! ¡La luz del Emblema de Joe
abre un agujero en la niebla!

dialog.english:
Okay! We'll get through that fog
before the hole closes up! Let's 
go, Zudomon!
dialog.translation:
¡Vale! ¡Cruzaremos la niebla antes
de que se cierre el agujero!
¡Vamos, Zudomon!

dialog.english:
I can't tell what's left and right
anymore.
dialog.translation:
Ya no distingo la izquierda de la
derecha.

dialog.english:
I can't see him very well, is he
drifting around?
dialog.translation:
No lo veo bien, ¿está flotando a
la deriva?

dialog.english:
Are you one of Myotismon's
minions?!
Look! It's a Tag and Crest.

This is the ori...ginal... eighth
child's...
dialog.translation:
Este es el ori...ginal... del
octavo niño...

dialog.english:
Tell me! Where'd you take
everyone?!

The International Exhibition
Center! Myotismon's trapped
everyone in there!
dialog.translation:
¡Tokyo Big Sight! ¡Myotismon tiene
a todos atrapados ahí!

dialog.english:
No! Why you, Myotismon... Sora, go
take Matt there!

It's almost been two hours since
Tai left. What's he up to?
dialog.translation:
Hace casi dos horas que Tai se
fue. ¿Qué estará haciendo?

dialog.english:
Tai told me you'd be here!
Myotismon's holding everyone at the
International Exhibition Center!
dialog.translation:
¡Tai me dijo que estarías aquí!
¡Myotismon tiene a todos en el
Tokyo Big Sight!

dialog.english:
If I defeat you, finding the
eighth child won't matter anymore!
You'll meet your end here!
dialog.translation:
¡Si te derroto, ya no importará
encontrar al octavo niño! ¡Aquí
morirás!

dialog.english:
It's just gonna keep dragging on
forever!

I'm the eighth child. I'll go
wherever you want, just stop
hurting everyone!
dialog.translation:
Soy el octavo niño. ¡Iré adonde
queráis, solo dejad de herir a
todos!

dialog.english:
What noble intentions. As you
wish...

Tai was relying on me to
protect Kari...
dialog.translation:
Tai confiaba en mí para proteger
a Kari...

dialog.english:
Matt! Regretting it won't
accomplish anything. We have to
save Kari!
dialog.translation:
¡Matt! Lamentarlo no sirve de
nada. ¡Tenemos que salvar a Kari!
